comparison: Both policies receive identical predicted report meanings within each reader. Only grouping and unresolved-scope handling change. Metadata never enters the interpreter.
response_reuse: One response per distinct normalized report text and reader, joined to all occurrences, including both packets in each pair. Packet/report occurrences are correlated; they are not independent model calls.
execution: Serial, alternating reader order by text. One response per request; no warmup or automatic retry.
failure_stop: Immediate stop on access/configuration/rate-limit/checkpoint/network errors, or three consecutive malformed replies. Missing/failed shared replies invalidate all dependent packet predictions.

reading.instructions: Interpret the focal component evidence in this report. Select fault, normal or unknown according to the report, respecting clause scope. Do not infer an incident disposition, freshness or service relationship.

criteria.fault: An explicit observation establishes failure or impairment of the focal component. A passing auxiliary check or an unconfirmed earlier alarm does not cancel an independent current fault observation.
criteria.normal: The focal component measurement establishes normal operation or explicitly rules out the stated fault. Fault-related words under negation do not establish a fault. Verified general service recovery is normal.
criteria.unknown: The focal reading is uncertain, suspected, inconclusive or not established. Distinguish uncertainty about the focal measurement from uncertainty about an unrelated check or earlier alarm.

reading.instructions: Interpret the focal component evidence in this report. Select fault, normal or unknown according to the report, respecting clause scope. Do not infer an incident disposition, freshness or service relationship. Judge the operation of the specific function this report explicitly measures, not the health of the whole component or wider service. Verified successful request intake or handler operation is normal for that measured function even if later registration or end-to-end completion is unmeasured. If the report instead measures completion, request acceptance alone leaves completion unknown. Success of a different function does not cancel an explicit malfunction of the measured function. Keep expected behavior, explicit malfunction and uncertainty distinct.
